create_base_hungarian_tracker: create a BaseHungarianTracker instance for tracking objects across video frames with configurable parameters
build_cost_matrix: build a cost matrix for matching current frame instances to previous frame instances using the Hungarian algorithm
run_tracker_update: run the tracker update method to assign persistent IDs to detected instances across consecutive frames
process_matched_instances: process matched instance indices to carry forward tracking IDs and increment ID periods
process_unmatched_previous_instances: process unmatched previous instances by incrementing lost frame counts and filtering by size thresholds
